notes: No patches needed. All automated flags (header-unlocated, cell-not-in-row, cell-cut-short, cell-spans-rows, text-between-rows, words insert/delete) were layout noise: the checker read Backgrounds/Party Bonds columns interleaved, and the list-style class tables are numbered lists in prose whose following headings/prose it treated as row text. Each list entry was compared programmatically against the joined pNNN.md font text (exact match incl. emphasis, e.g. '*Dazed.*', '*Pierce the Veil,*', '***Hunger For Blood***', '**17.**') and visually against the page images. Die headers are inferred/derived from prose: d66 (Backgrounds 'Roll d66', Party Bonds 'roll d66'), d12 (each class list 'roll 1d12'), d8 (Mutagen: 'Roll 1d8 for the Mutagen effect' in Alchemy row 11; rows print as (i)-(viii)), Spell Like Blessings uses d12 values 7-12 as printed. Die numbers print bold in the source but are plain in the notes, consistent with the sample convention. 'Sever Arcarnum' is the book's consistent spelling (10 occurrences), not a typo. Blessings row '7-12' is printed as '7-12.'; note keeps 7-12.
